summary_rationale: SK hynix holds a verified packaging and thermal-yield moat in High Bandwidth Memory (50%-58% HBM revenue share, ~70% initial HBM4 allocations, Advanced MR-MUF yield edge, and >50% LTA coverage for 2027-2028 capacity), lifting 9M 2026 consolidated revenue to KRW 236.51T (74.4% DRAM, 25.2% NAND Flash) and Q3 2026 operating profit to KRW 83.33T (79.7% margin) atop KRW 114.46T in cash and short-term investments vs KRW 15.80T in debt. However, the November 16 and November 20, 2026 Form 6-K filings surface material watch items: two external customers represent 24.87% of 9M 2026 revenue (14.79% and 10.08%), trade receivables surged 225% to KRW 59.12T (compressing 9M CFO/PAT conversion to 83.7%), unrecognized PP&E capex commitments jumped 6.4x to KRW 42.71T, KRW 122.48T in FVTPL investment assets plus $72.13B in USD monetary assets create multi-trillion won quarterly mark-to-market and FX swings (KRW 7.22T per 10% won move), and Korea environmental/safety sanctions plus China SAMR/export rules add operational friction alongside the KRW 100T FY2026 shareholder return plan.
